items.summary: Recommendation: continue only the existing bounded, reversible evidence, repair, and measurement work; reject new queue tasks, production changes, launch proposals, and revenue or ROI claims. Attribution is incomplete, direct costs are unavailable, and missing telemetry is not evidence of zero performance. No new actionable sites remain because defensible candidates are already covered by active workstreams. Decision question: authorize continuation until the stated acceptance and measurement thresholds are met?
